subject: Low-latency inference hiring request and comp bands
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Low-latency inference hiring request and comp bands

Hi Jonas and Markus,

Headcount ask: I’m requesting approval to open two backend SWE roles on the Low‑Latency Inference team to support the next phase of our runtime throughput and latency SLAs. Details below and attached packet includes comp bands and scorecards.

Roles requested (2 FTE):
- Senior Runtime Engineer (L5) — focus: kernel-level inference optimizations, KV cache improvements, continuous batching improvements
- Platform Reliability Engineer (L4) — focus: autoscaler tuning, observability + tracing for token-level latency regressions

Justification summary:
- Current QPS: 6k sustained, peak 12k in EU region; observed p95 generation latency at 420ms (our target is <=220ms for key enterprise customers).
- Sales asks: two enterprise pilots in Q2 require sub-50ms median serving for embeddings/rerank (multi-model routing scenario). Without headcount, we will miss contractual onboarding timelines and risk revenue deferrals.
- Cost impact: estimated $0.8M annualized savings after optimizations (better batching + KV caching + quantization profiles) compared to current spend trajectory.

Comp bands (attached spreadsheet):
- L5 target base: $210k–$240k, total OTE (with 15% bonus + stock) ~$255k–$295k
- L4 target base: $150k–$170k, total OTE ~$185k–$210k
We propose offer flexibility: up to 10% above midpoint for exceptional candidates, with exec approval required above that.

Budget and timing:
- Open reqs: 2 FTE, hiring plan to close by end of Q2 2027
- Impact to FY27 headcount run-rate: incremental ~ $600k fully‑loaded for 2027 (partial year)
- Hiring owner: Mina Haddad (me) and recruiter Perry Lewis (cc’d offline)

Ask: 1) approval to open the two reqs against the Runtime headcount plan; 2) explicit sign-off on the comp bands and up-to-10% flexibility; 3) confirm budget code to charge (I currently show: ENG-RUNTIME-27 on allocation draft).

Attachments: hc-packet-low-latency-2027.pdf, comp-band-L4-L5-2027.xlsx

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Low-latency inference hiring request and comp bands

On Wed, 10 Feb 2027 at 09:12 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Jonas and Markus,
> 
> Headcount ask: I’m requesting approval to open two backend SWE roles on the Low‑Latency Inference team...

Thanks for the packet — good framing and clear revenue linkage. I’m supportive of the two reqs in principle. Before giving full approval I need:
1) Confirmation from Finance that the incremental run‑rate fits the FY27 hiring constraint (Hannah, can you confirm availability against ENG-RUNTIME-27?).
2) A short risk/rollback plan if we can’t hit Q2 candidate start dates (e.g., contractor bridge, reduced scope).
3) A one‑pager scorecard we can share with recruiting to speed screen criteria (please attach to the doc link).

If Finance signs off today I can greenlight recruitment by tomorrow.

Jonas
VP Engineering

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Low-latency inference hiring request and comp bands

Jonas / Mina — we reviewed the packet and the comp bands with Finance. Short answers:
- Budget: We can reallocate $520k of headcount budget from the general infrastructure reserve to ENG-RUNTIME-27 for FY27. That covers the 2 FTE proposal for the remainder of the year.
- Charge code: use ENG-RUNTIME-27 for the hires; update headcount tracker by COB Friday.
- Approvals: comp bands are fine; please route all offers >=10% above midpoint to Markus for sign-off.

A couple notes: given tight timelines, I recommend we keep the L5 band competitive on stock refresh availability — I’ve flagged additional RSUs as negotiable within the offer approval process.

Hannah
Head of Finance (Engineering Partnering)

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Low-latency inference hiring request and comp bands

Thanks — quick operational note from Staffing / Capacity:
- We can start requisition creation tomorrow once Mina provides the job profiles and scorecards.
- Hiring velocity: realistic estimate to offer = 6–8 weeks for L5, 4–6 weeks for L4 (assuming standard interview loop).
- Contingency: Nimbus Consulting (ops@nimbus-consult.com) has availability to provide a 3‑month contractor to help with autoscaler tuning immediately; estimate $90k for 3 months fully loaded. We should decide if we want to post the contractor option in parallel.

If we run both tracks (FTE + short contractor), we can meet the Q2 ramp with less SLA risk.

—Dev
Director, Talent & Capacity Planning

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Low-latency inference hiring request and comp bands

Appreciate the packet and the quick turn from Finance. Approvals:
- Greenlight to open both reqs under ENG-RUNTIME-27.
- Compensation: bands approved as proposed. Offers up to 10% above midpoint are approved; anything above that needs my explicit OK.
- Contractor: approve parallel contractor engagement with Nimbus if recruiting falls behind; Dev, please proceed with SOW and cap at $100k for 3 months.

Conditions:
1) Mina — provide the 1‑page scorecards by EOD tomorrow and the final JD for each role so Recruiting can post.
2) Keep me in the loop on any offers above midpoint or if we need to expand the comp band due to candidate market.

Markus
CTO, Redwood Inference

On Mon, 15 Feb 2027 at 14:35 Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Draft approval complete — issuing formal note to HR after Mina attachments are added.
